build_MLP_from_config: build an MLP model from a list of feature sizes with configurable activation function
build_DropoutMLP_from_config: build a DropoutMLP model with feature sizes and dropout rate for regularization
create_MLP_sequence: create a sequence of affine layers with elementwise activation using MLP.from_config
create_DropoutMLP_stochastic: create a sequence of affine layers with stochastic dropout and activation using DropoutMLP.from_config
test_MLP_inheritance: test that MLP and DropoutMLP inherit from pz.nn.Sequential as pytree dataclasses
